calibration_scope: Inverse of original nominal rounded calibration. Published coefficient range describes SFR calibration, not brightness uncertainty: the Table7 component and coefficient covary. Any reciprocal range holding the tabulated SFR component fixed is counterfactual conversion only. Components have no separate quoted rms. FUV is Galactic-extinction corrected.
interpretation: Neither band has exact monotone correspondence to the historical signed residual. This descriptive screen does not reject an arbitrary retarded or spatially nonlocal stress kernel; such a kernel and its physical normalization have not been derived.

scope.band_quantity: nominal face-on I_nu*cos(i), MJy/sr; use saved interpolation operands only
scope.bin_endpoints: left closed/right open, last right closed; boundaries are existing Leroy knots, descriptive and not fitted phases
scope.parent_authorization: root saved-data scalar audit; no producer/helper/operator/field replay
scope.perfect_mirror_screen: Exact monotone mirror would require Spearman +1 or -1 and no opposing adjacent changes for that prechosen orientation. Both orientation counts reported, no sign/gain selection. Does not reject arbitrary nonlocal or retarded constitutive kernels.
scope.physical_velocity_scope: historical Q1/legacy diagnostic readouts retained; full calculated-metric geodesic final velocity not supplied
scope.residual_sign: model minus observed km/s; quoted observational one-error demand classes preserved separately
statistics: adjacent band-change versus residual-change sign counts; same/opposite/tie all reported
per-bin residual signs and inherited one-error demand counts
scope.uncertainty: Only total SFR and stellar-surface RMS are quoted. Separate FUV/24micron RMS and cross-radius covariance absent; no p-values/confidence level or brightness-error claim.

source_accounting: Unobscured FUV and dust-obscured/reprocessed 24micron tracer contributions; distinct band information, not two independently calibrated native stresses. Present tracers do not supply a source history.

uncertainties.rotation_sigma: original quoted observational error; no covariance or model uncertainty supplied
uncertainties.total_SFR_RMS: copied only; not allocated between bands or propagated as intensity uncertainty
